template_name: The Unsaid Yet Said - Permanent Hybrid Episode

structure.purpose: Hook, tension, core question. No channel housekeeping before the hook.

structure.visual: B-roll, workplace illustrations, animated statistics, charts, frameworks, key phrases and scene changes
structure.purpose: Evidence-led narrative and explanation. Avatar is off screen.
Synthesis, final thought and channel signature.

adaptive_rule.description: For episodes between 7 and 10 minutes, keep the opening at 25 seconds and closing at 30 seconds; expand or contract only the visual-storytelling middle.

production_rules.narration_voice: Anurag cloned voice for the full episode
production_rules.background_music: Optional and always secondary to narration
production_rules.avatar_visibility: Opening and closing only in hybrid mode
production_rules.hrtechify_logo: Persistent subtle watermark throughout; exact approved HRTechify logo asset only
production_rules.avatar_branding: Exact approved HRTechify logo on T-shirt
